subject: Payee identity completion & PO integration for Keenwell Supplies

Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Payee identity completion & PO integration for Keenwell Supplies

Jordan —

Thanks for taking the call earlier. To finish the vendor master profile and enable PO creation from our procurement system we need the following items:

- Completed vendor onboarding form (I attached the Redwood template here)
- W-9 (or equivalent tax doc) with the legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices
- Bank confirmation letter or voided check for ACH remit (bank account name + routing + account number)
- Primary invoice contact (name, email, phone) and PO acknowledgement contact (if different)

Can you share those by EOD tomorrow? Once we receive them I’ll route to our Finance team for verification and kick off the master record creation. If Keenwell prefers a DocuSign flow I can send that link instead.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
(415) 555-0113

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Payee identity completion & PO integration for Keenwell Supplies

Thanks Jordan — looping in Finance (Laura) to validate the tax and bank docs.

Aditya: next steps from our side —
1) Laura will confirm the EIN on file and the W-9 match.
2) I’ll create a ticket in FreshService to request vendor-master creation with the following attributes: legal_name, remit_email, billing_email, remit_account_last4, EIN. Please confirm if you want the remit method set to ACH with net-30 terms.
3) We’ll create the Redwood-side vendor code and share the vendor ID and first PO number once available.

If Keenwell needs faster payment terms for onboarding, say a one-time expedited payment, let me know and I’ll escalate.

– Monica
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

All looks good — W-9 entity (Keenwell Supplies, LLC) matches the bank letter and the EIN resolves in our vendor verification service. I verified routing/account numbers match the confirmation letter.

I flagged the account for ACH remit and set credit terms to Net 30 per Redwood standard. No red flags on sanctions or PEP lists. I’ve created Finance profile RED-V-2028-084 and initiated vendor-master creation in SAP. Expect master record to be available by Monday, 09 Apr.

Reference numbers: FreshService FS-5591 (vendor creation ticket), SAP vendor RED-V-2028-084.
